recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. If a historical Argonaut guide package or terminology server cache still needs correction for the guide-specific URL, handle that outside current FHIR-core source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-12695 reported an IG Publisher QA terminology validation failure for an Argonaut language value set, where BCP-47 language codes such as urn:ietf:bcp:47#en-US, and reportedly en, were not validating. The issue was Published/Persuasive with auto-approved resolution, and the Jira comment says the problem was already done after FHIR-I discussion.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-12695 was found. The relevant core language value set state was already present before this issue was filed: commit 43c0810c74eadeb1efbd6bafca4d55f055c9d830 for FHIR-12346 added en-US to source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml on 2016-11-16, and the current value set also contains en.
additional_context: The failing URL in the Jira text was an Argonaut guide URL rather than the current core value set URL. In current core source, the Argonaut IG entry is commented out in source/igs.xml and the exact http://fhir.org/guides/argonaut/ValueSet/languages URL is absent. Current source and the current build surface both expose http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages with BCP-47 codes en and en-US.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source edit is needed because the authoritative Common Languages value set already includes the relevant codes and the Argonaut-specific guide artifact is outside active current core build content.
